limitations: Twelve-month windows have different start months and calendar years. Calendar month, dock pair and time-stratum mix are standardized, but weather, rider composition and pandemic changes are not controlled.
Month-specific before/after cells can be one or two years apart; lateJune and September straddlecalendar year cohorts.
No bicycle GPS route or stable rider identity is available. Dock endpoints indicate plausible bridge routes only.
Classic member riders are a selected subset, not all cyclists.
Neighboring ManhattanBridge can be affected by diversion. Relative change is not a causalestimate.

Conditional sampling intervals cluster by date, preserving across-bridge covariance, and hold support/weights fixed. They do not cover serial dependence, repeated riders, route uncertainty, selection or causalidentification.
Within-cell median/p90 averages are not population median/p90.
Elapsed rental times include stops/docking but exclude access/egress walks or waiting for a bicycle.
